03 / open questions

Worth thinking
through.

Where does a service really begin?

Before a person reaches a website, there is already a question, a constraint, or something they need to do. That earlier moment belongs in the work too.

What happens after the handoff?

Following a link is one step. What comes next, who helps, and whether someone can finish matter just as much.

Who can use what we’ve made?

Access shows up in language, structure, keyboard use, readable text, and alternatives. Those choices belong throughout the experience.

04 / a little context

Behind the work.
